import json

transcript_path = "/Users/huncho/.gemini/antigravity-ide/brain/80c2d294-d8d4-46e4-bb1b-160fa56b5bdc/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl"

with open(transcript_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for i, line in enumerate(f):
        # The DOM tree representation typically has a lot of "nodeName" or "attributes" keys
        if "nodeName" in line and "betting__container" in line:
            print(f"Line {i+1} might contain DOM tree!")
            try:
                data = json.loads(line)
                print(f"  keys: {list(data.keys())}")
                if "content" in data:
                    print("  content length:", len(str(data["content"])))
                    with open("extracted_dom_log.json", "w") as out:
                        out.write(str(data["content"]))
                    print("  Saved content to extracted_dom_log.json")
            except Exception as e:
                print("  error parsing:", e)
